UC-810.en: Always allow this exact command in {folder}.
UC-810.hi: {folder} में ठीक यही कमांड हमेशा चलने दें।
UC-810.hi_by: always_core words (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-810.note: the approval card's Always for this matter option on a command, for Claude or ChatGPT. {folder} is the working folder relative to the matter ("Drafts"), or "this matter's folder" at its top. Claude's shell starts in the matter's folder for every command (Clauseo sets CLAUDE_BASH_MAINTAIN_PROJECT_WORKING_DIR), so its {folder} is always "this matter's folder". Offered only for a program on Clauseo's list, with options the list allows and every file inside the matter. Clauseo keeps the command text byte for byte, with its folder for ChatGPT, and answers the same command there later

UC-811.en: Always allow changes to files in this matter.
UC-811.hi: इस मामले की फ़ाइलों में बदलाव हमेशा करने दें।
UC-811.hi_by: always_core words (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-811.note: the approval card's Always for this matter option on a file edit, for Claude or ChatGPT. Clauseo keeps one rule (Edit(*)) that covers every file inside the matter folder by its real path, never a file outside it, nor .clauseo, .claude, .codex, .agents, .mcp.json, AGENTS.md, AGENTS.override.md, CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md

UC-812.hi: इस मामले में {site} को हमेशा अनुमति दें।
UC-812.hi_by: always_core words (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-812.note: the approval card's Always for this matter option on a web page (Claude's WebFetch, or a network card). {site} is the exact host, and the rule covers every page on it

UC-814.hi: अनुमति दी गई: इस मामले के लिए हमेशा।

UC-815.hi: आपने पहले इसके लिए मना किया था। {agent} ने फिर पूछा, इसलिए Clauseo ने आपकी ओर से मना कर दिया।
